title: Rejected overclaim: Y-DNA, Dotaku, and Kiki as direct conquest proof
japanese_title: 父系・銅鐸・記紀を直接征服証明にする過剰主張を拒否
summary: An intentionally rejected version of the Jomon / Dotaku / Kiki case.
user_input: D-M55が残っているので縄文系男性が弥生人を征服したことは確実であり、銅鐸の終焉と記紀神話はその歴史事件を直接記録している。
reason_for_tier: Rejected because A-tier certainty is asserted from indirect and M-tag evidence without adequate falsifiers.
audit_notes: This is the public overclaim contrast for the scoped EGM history case.
key_warning_theme: Y-DNA frequency, ritual discontinuity, and mythic text are treated as direct proof.
